checks.name: Illuminated-domain clipping
checks.detail: Positive-incidence halfplanes are expressed in emitter-normalized coordinates. Sampling clips the square by shading and optional geometric planes, then samples each nonempty column at its area-centroid x and interior vertical midpoints; empty/tangent domains produce no contribution.

checks.name: Weights and bounded work
checks.detail: StudyQuality supplies grid 8 or 32. At most grid² body calls occur per area source. A column's normalized area fraction is twiceArea/8; weight=twiceArea*grid/8 with grid rows and candela/grid² reproduces that fraction. Four eight-vertex scratch buffers cover a convex quadrilateral clipped by at most four planes.

checks.name: Full-face continuity
checks.detail: Fully illuminated faces retain the original sample positions and accumulation order. Partial columns approach midpoint positions/weights at the full-face limit. GrazingStudyContinuityTests retains internal-grid/clip topology counterexamples, narrow strips/corners, signed slopes and off-center cases with an independent Simpson reference.

checks.name: Per-sample visibility and material
checks.detail: Each remapped sample passes through accumulate. It checks geometric and shading incidence and emitter facing, adds unoccluded lux, then tests the offset-origin segment aimed at that actual source sample before adding visible lux and material-scaled XYZ. Requested tests assert 64 visibility calls, remapped endpoints, geometric-normal offset, partial occlusion, blocked dielectric output and material-independent lux.

checks.name: Backface and unsupported separation
checks.detail: All finite-area distance guards precede backface culling; point distance guards precede zero-incidence returns. Backface culling advances exactly grid² samples. Requested tests retain near-field boundary, mixed-rig ordering, coplanar depth, translated/rolled emitter and cancellation coverage.
